title: Voice-Controlled AI Operations Assistant
desc:
I need a fully-custom AI assistant that responds to natural voice commands and takes care of three core areas of my daily workflow:

• E-commerce: connect to my store APIs, monitor stock, adjust pricing, push new listings, and send shipping updates without manual clicks.  
• Crypto trading: pull real-time data, run predictive models, and place or close positions automatically under rules I define.

Python will be the foundation, with libraries such as FastAPI or Flask for the backend, speech-to-text and text-to-speech engines for the voice layer, and secure API hooks (Shopify, Binance, Coinbase, Stripe, QuickBooks, etc.) for each domain. • Controller programming suggestions (run times, cycles) tailored to turf versus flower beds.  
• Installation notes I can hand to my landscaper for a smooth build.  

I will supply measurements, photos and current water-pressure data as soon as we start. Files can be delivered in PDF and either DWG or an editable vector format. If you have questions about slopes, soil type or plant varieties, just ask—accuracy now will save us both time later.
